call_points.text: Management expects more than a 50% increase in turnover in the coming months but declined an exact FY27 forecast.
New Dhule NPK/DAP plant targeted at around 60% utilisation; existing facilities expected at around 90%.
Q1 EBITDA and PAT gains came from lower-cost March raw material inventory, which management says is now exhausted.
Ammonia prices have started easing but rock phosphate remains at similar elevated levels; MRP and NBS rates were raised.
Funding for the October 2026 phase is tied up with bankers and internal accruals; no equity dilution planned at present.
Funding structure for the October 2027 expansion is still under discussion and not finalised.
Kharif sowing was around 183 lakh hectares by end-June versus 236.5 lakh hectares a year earlier, shifting fertilizer application later.
Industry SSP sales grew 28% YoY and NPK sales 33% YoY in April-May 2026 even as production fell.
West Asia crisis seen as limited risk as rock phosphate is sourced from Egypt and Jordan on a different shipping route.
Green Ammonia supply agreement signed, with supplies expected to commence from 1 April 2029.
Completed a 1:5 stock split, face value ₹10 to ₹2, effective 3 July 2026.
Dhule DAP/NPK facility (330,000 MTPA) and phosphoric acid (99,000 MTPA) targeted before October 2026.
Dhule Next Phase expansion targeted for commissioning by October 2027.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received notice of demand amounting to Rs. 7 crore. The order has made an addition to the Company’s taxable income on account of outstanding trade payables to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) as at 31st March 2024. The said addition has been made on the grounds that the payments to such MSME vendors were not made within the prescribed time limits under the applicable provisions of law. The Company has filed a rectification application with the Tax Authority in response to the demand notice. Upon examination, the Income Tax Department accepted the Company's request. Accordingly, the error was rectified under the provisions of section 154 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, and the demand payable has been Nil.
tax_litigation.status: Despite this order, the company is taking the necessary steps to file an appeal against the said order within the prescribed limitation period.

operating_notes.text: Total fertiliser manufacturing capacity stands at ~900,000 MTPA (SSP: 570,000 MTPA, NPK/DAP: 330,000 MTPA) and targeted to reach ~1.56 million MTPA by FY28.
FY26 plant capacity utilisation reached 98% for SSP and 100% for NPK-DAP.
Dhule and Sagar project costs aggregate to ₹675 Cr, with ₹460 Cr incurred through Q4FY26 and balance to be spent within 3-4 months.
Fertilizer production was 99,224 MT against sales of 101,583 MT in Q1FY27.
SSP utilisation was around 45% and NPK/DAP around 43% in Q1FY27.
Rock phosphate is primarily sourced from Egypt and Jordan; a Green Ammonia supply agreement starts supplies from 1 April 2029.
The DAP/NPK Fertilizer Plant at Dhule, Maharashtra has been successfully commissioned and is ready to operate, awaiting only the statutory raw material licence.

timeline.summary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited held Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on April 20, 2026, with audio recording available on its website.
Madhya Bharat Agro held its Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 50-60% FY27 top-line growth and ₹4,000 Cr revenue by FY28.
Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited held an Analysts/Investors Group meet on May 20, 2026, via virtual mode from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM, with no unpublished price-sensitive information shared.
Madhya Bharat Agro approved a 1:5 stock split, a ₹1,000 Cr enabling fundraise resolution, and an increase in borrowing limits to ₹2,500 Cr ahead of its AGM.
Madhya Bharat Agro scheduled its 29th Annual General Meeting for June 24, 2026.
On 15 July 2026 MBAPL's Q1FY27 call reported revenue of ₹416 Cr, EBITDA of ₹66 Cr (up 16% YoY) and PAT of ₹33 Cr (up 17% YoY), with the next Dhule phase due October 2026.
Madhya Bharat Agro announced the successful commissioning of its Dhule DAP/NPK plant, with commercial production awaiting statutory raw material licences.
